feynman_certification.listener_verdict: This is genuinely great. You hooked me in the first 2 seconds because anyone who's built a RAG app or queried an LLM for citations knows the pain of fake papers. Beat 2 immediately explains why naive top-k vector retrieval falls apart, and Beat 3-4 give actual architectural mechanics (two-phase scoring, citation tethering) instead of cringe metaphors like 'magic bookshelves'. Beat 5 dropping the 58% vs 92% LitQA stat seals the deal.
